key.name: text
key.summary: Text shown on the screensaver (empty = your user name)

key.name: idle-delay
key.summary: Seconds of inactivity before the screensaver starts

key.name: font-size
key.summary: Terminal font size in points (Omarchy uses 18; 28 gives a short name the same screen presence)

key.name: font-style
key.summary: ASCII art font style for the text

key.name: skip-fullscreen
key.summary: Do not start while a fullscreen window is focused

key.name: disabled-effects
key.summary: Effects excluded from the random rotation

key.name: preview
key.summary: Incremented by the preferences window to request a preview
